name: DJI FPV / Avata
bird_discriminant: Wideband symmetric sidebands vs low asymmetric bird flap
detection_notes: Higher rotor RPM widens the micro-Doppler spread

name: DJI Phantom 4 (legacy)
bird_discriminant: Rotor blade flash vs bird wing-beat modulation

name: Autel EVO Max 4T
bird_discriminant: Symmetric rotor sidebands absent in birds
detection_notes: Comparable-mass quad; spread scales with rotor tip speed

name: FPV 5-inch (analog)
bird_discriminant: Strong symmetric blade flash despite tiny body RCS
detection_notes: Small radar cross-section needs high-band radar and good clutter rejection

name: FPV 5-inch (digital HD)

name: Parrot ANAFI / Ai
bird_discriminant: Symmetric rotor sidebands vs asymmetric bird beat
detection_notes: Lightweight quad; low RCS shortens usable range

micro_doppler_spread: narrow prop sidebands + strong steady bulk Doppler
bird_discriminant: Steady bulk Doppler and few HERM lines differ from flapping birds

name: Shahed-136 / Geran-2
micro_doppler_spread: pusher-prop sidebands + steady ~185 km/h bulk Doppler
bird_discriminant: Steady high-speed bulk Doppler unlike any bird
detection_notes: Radar-detectable despite zero RF; low-RCS delta demands sensitive radar

name: WiFi micro / toy quadcopter
bird_discriminant: Rotor flash present but weak returns
detection_notes: Very small RCS keeps detection range short even at W-band
